Metropolitan Area Planning Council
44 School Street Boston, Massachusetts 02108
Richard M Doherty Executive Director
(617) 523-2454
November 13, 1975
Mr. David Strohm, Director Office of Community Development City Hall Boston, MA
RE: Environmental Impact Statement, Clearance of Unsafe Buildings, Community Development Block Grant Program
(EIS-76-9; Received 10/15/75)
Dear Mr. Strohm:
In accordance with the regulations issued pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws, Chapter 30, Section 62, we have received the above referenced Environmental Impact Statement.
We find this proposal for the demolition of 900 abandoned and unsafe residential buildings over a two year period to be consistent with regional goals and objectives.
Mr. Robert Kenney, Director of the Boston Redevelopment Authority, feels that the Report adequately addresses the environmental impacts of the proposed project. Mr. Richard Mertens, Environmental Review Officer of the BRA, feels that the Report is comprehensive in its assessment of the project. We enclose a copy of their comments.
Very truly yours,
Richard M. Doherty
Executive Director
